dedupe_keys.name: carioca mapbus bus mobility and environmental indicators dataset for rio de janeiro 2014 2023

description: Carioca_MapBus is a dataset of spatiotemporal information on the mobility of municipal buses in Rio de Janeiro from 2014 to 2023, combined with estimated emissions of polluting gases and rainfall volumes. It is the first to combine bus observations with neighbourhoods, rainfall regions, rainfall volumes and pollutant emissions, and its format eases integration with other Rio de Janeiro City Hall datasets. It was described by Diego Carvalho, Vinícius Vancellote, Eduardo Ogasawara and colleagues in a Scientific Data descriptor published on 26 September 2025. Coverage is one city. Licence: not stated for the resource; the describing article (doi:10.1038/s41597-025-05755-6) is CC-BY-4.0. Access is free of charge. Caveats: the authors note data gaps, as the path from vehicle to storage has failure points, so the data are complete only for some periods, and emissions are estimated from average diesel bus rates. The data support analysis of rain impacts on bus operations, congestion and service reliability, and emissions studies. They complement the Bogotá transport open data catalogued here.
